title: Third measles death recorded in US in 2026
description: A 40-year-old woman in the U.S. state of Pennsylvania has died of measles, authorities said Sunday, bringing this year's death toll from the highly contagious, preventable disease to three, amid declining vaccination rates.

title: Philippine ferry fire victims may take months to identify, authorities say
description: Authorities in the Philippines said on Sunday it could take weeks or months to identify the victims of a ferry fire that killed 76 people, as forensic experts begin collecting and comparing DNA samples from charred remains and investigators determine what caused one of the country's deadliest maritime disasters in recent years.

title: USGS: Lithium in Carolinas Could Replace Imports for a Century or More
description: RESTON, Va. — The southern Appalachian region of the eastern United States contains an estimated 1.43 million metric tons of undiscovered, economically recoverable lithium oxide, enough to replace 201 years of U.S. imports at last year’s level, according to new research by the U.S. Geological Survey.
